description: The plot illustrates BLEU scores as a function of “the length of gold prefix,” showing two series labeled “Consistency: wait-1” and “Inconsistency: wait-9.” The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 20 with major ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 23 to 29 with labeled ticks at each integer. The “Consistency: wait-1” line is blue with open circle markers and a dashed style; it starts near 24.6 at x=0, dips to about 23.7 at x=1, then generally rises across the axis, reaching about 26.0 around x=10, about 27.0 at x=16, and ending near 28.1 at x=20. The “Inconsistency: wait-9” line is red with filled square markers and a dashed style; it begins around 25.1 at x=0, increases to roughly 25.7–25.8 by x=2–3, reaches about 26.0 around x=5–6, then fluctuates around the mid-25s, dropping to about 25.1 around x=14–15, and finishes near 25.9 at x=20.
